title: SM-S4315R wheel servo, supplier specifications
scope: Supplier 12.2 kgf cm / 50 RPM reference; not a continuous-torque or measured 6 V guarantee.

title: SpringRC continuous-rotation servo catalogue
scope: Manufacturer alternate SM-S4315R 13.4 kgf cm / 56 RPM; test voltage not clear in retrieved catalogue.

title: 25 kg continuous leg servo, supplier specifications
scope: 21 kgf cm at 5 V, 25 at 6.8 V, 2.6-3.4 A stall at 6.8 V; not position servo or continuous torque rating.

title: LM2596 converter module
scope: Board advertised 2 A continuous, 3 A peak; cooling matters.

title: Texas Instruments LM2596 datasheet
scope: IC limits and thermal design do not certify an arbitrary module at 3 A continuous.

title: LTC3780 buck-boost module
scope: Module current/power labels; installed current limit and undervoltage setting unknown.

title: Analog Devices LTC3780 datasheet
scope: Current sensing, limiting and undervoltage behavior depend on implementation.

title: 12 V 3000 mAh battery listing
scope: 10.8-12.6 V / 3 Ah; no verified pack discharge or BMS trip current.

title: 85 mm rubber wheel listing
scope: 85 mm diameter, 30 mm width; 6 mm coupling needs actual servo adapter verification.

title: AS5600 module listing
scope: 12-bit magnetic angle sensor module; actual TALOS sensors are on hips, not wheels.

title: ams AS5600 datasheet, hosted by Seeed
scope: Magnet status, 12-bit resolution and specified accuracy are distinct.

title: TDK InvenSense MPU-6000/6050 specification
scope: Six-axis accelerometer and gyro, not absolute wheel velocity or heading.

title: NASA Fastener Design Manual, RP-1228
scope: General fastener load, material, grip and preload principles; no TALOS bolt grade or PLA tightening torque established.

title: igus plain-bearing FAQ
scope: Bearing wear depends on shaft, load, motion and temperature; tested bearing polymer data is not printed PLA data.

title: MuJoCo equality/connect reference
scope: Closed-linkage point constraints used in the executable model.

title: Gmsh reference manual
scope: Native STEP tetrahedral meshing used in the screening FEA.

title: Kayden Knapik robot project
scope: Author hardware and simulation workflow; different actuators and joint count from TALOS.

title: BDX-R MjLab source repository
scope: Isaac Lab style API using MuJoCo Warp; not a ready-made TALOS policy.

title: Kelton Serra self-balancing robot PCB project
scope: Primary creator page for the Arduino inspiration project; does not supply TALOS gains.

title: Upkie wheel-legged robot project
scope: Open-source wheel-legged simulation/control reference with different hardware.

title: Stephane Caron, capture point explanation
scope: General capture concept; this report's small-angle velocity-capture screen is separately derived, not a full TALOS model.
